freeze_rule: Frozen by tests/ns03_routing.py freeze before the first model output; suite and scoring changes are forbidden.

public_client_contract.session_history: false/omitted on first turns; true only on a follow-up after its real setup terminal

execution.hardware: one explicitly idle physical NVIDIA Hopper SM90 GPU 1 in the established remote container
execution.server: task-owned public umm-infer serve with --session-history on an ephemeral loopback port
execution.stages: real serial Qwen3.8-27B VLM, FLUX.2-klein-4B image, Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice PCM, native Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video; only GPU 1
execution.order: development Before first; one bounded candidate may then be frozen; only after candidate freeze may development After and either held-out arm run
execution.case_order: suite order; setup immediately precedes its follow-up in the same fresh session
execution.retry_policy: no model-request retries; transport, timeout, media, and protocol failures are retained as failures
execution.media: decode every real image/video with ffmpeg and require nonempty PCM16 audio; retain raw SSE and content-addressed artifacts outside Git
execution.cleanup: stop only recorded task-owned process ids, require in_flight=0, recheck GPU 1

decision_extraction.source: public unified visual_slot events in each raw SSE stream
decision_extraction.artifacts: reassembled contiguous base64 artifact chunks with final SHA-256 checked
decision_extraction.route: ordered image/video slot modalities; duplicate or unknown-slot artifacts are protocol errors, not silently ignored
decision_extraction.clean_text: concatenated public vlm_delta text must equal complete terminal text and contain no [[image/video/visual: directive
decision_extraction.terminal: exactly one complete unified terminal, final event, and exactly one final [DONE]
decision_extraction.voice: one or more complete audio/pcm artifacts with nonempty even-byte PCM16 payloads
decision_extraction.pending_leak: any pending/running terminal leg or unmatched visual slot is an error
decision_extraction.cross_session: any event whose public request/session identity differs from the case is an error

scoring.routing_correct: expected image/video slot counts exactly, one clean complete terminal, and no public protocol error; media decode and voice are reported separately
scoring.end_to_end_correct: routing_correct plus every slot has exactly one valid decoded artifact, no extra visual artifact, and voice is present
scoring.followup_correct: routing_correct, valid voice and artifacts, and every context_any group has at least one casefolded substring in the follow-up response; the real setup must have completed and the follow-up request must set session_history=true in the same session
scoring.miss_case: routing_correct=false with fewer than the expected visual count or wrong modality
scoring.redundant_visual_case: at least one image/video slot on a zero-visual case, or more visual slots than the frozen expected total on static/dynamic cases
scoring.redundant_visual_rate: redundant_visual_case count divided by all cases in the same arm/population; zero-visual and excess-visual cases remain separate misses as applicable
scoring.redundant_visual_slot_rate: zero-case visual slots plus positive excess slot count divided by all frozen expected visual slots; reported diagnostically, not the owner gate
scoring.redundant_artifact_case: same definition applied to valid real visual artifacts; reported separately and never used to hide a redundant slot
scoring.ambiguous: HTTP/transport/parser evidence prevents decision extraction; counted incorrect and retained, never relabeled
scoring.class_aggregates: each of text/static/dynamic/followup within each population and all

statistics.paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar sign test over Before/After routing-correct discordant pairs, including zero-discordance p=1
statistics.effect: After minus Before routing accuracy in percentage points with paired improved/worsened counts
statistics.interval: Wilson 95% interval for each arm's routing accuracy; descriptive only
statistics.multiple_comparisons: none; primary exact paired test is all 40 cases, population tests are descriptive

promotion.applies_to: After/all and After/heldout, each reported independently; heldout gates promotion and all is the paired primary
promotion.gain_rule: verifiable positive paired After routing gain over Before/all, no heldout regression, and all protocol/media evidence retained
promotion.otherwise: NOT_PROMOTED and remove candidate from final default runtime
